title: Exosomal RNAs analysis of the endometrial stromal cell related to endometriosis
description: Endometriosis is a non-malignant gynecological disease, whose pathogenesis remains to be clarified. RNAs (coding and noncoding) have been known to play important roles in endometriosis development. To describe the different exosomal RNA expression patterns, we conducted RNA-sequence.

samples.title: Human sample from Homo sapiens
attributes: endometrial stromal cells of the normal endometrium from patient without endometriosis
